planner.question: Construct actual bad witnesses for the same universal machine at the exact polynomial stage and isolate the surviving unrestricted competitors.
planner.strategy: Encode arbitrary SAT and independent pin pattern in a common input suffix; enumerate and avoid clock-limited outputs.
planner.alternative: Audit why full-input programs survive and exhibit a polynomial solver for empty-source pin family.
planner.stop_rule: Do not turn a fixed exponent lower bound into the all-exponent condition.
literature_leads: Prior exact U equivalence; elementary tape locality and finite avoidance. No novelty claim.

construct.claim: For every sufficiently large n divisible by four the exact H_(n,s_1(n)) is satisfiable. For fixed k a polynomial SAT-preserving embedding defeats all prefix-blind programs and leaves O(L^(k-1)) possible description strings.
construct.scope: Identical prior U, explicit unary selector encoding, three-symbol general tape interpreter and length-weighted clock; all programs quantified.
construct.derivation: Lift short clauses with two guard variables, choose a pin pattern missing from blind outputs; use exact head/output-read horizon and description lengths.
unresolved_steps: Defeat the remaining unrestricted full-input programs at every k.
candidate_tests: Actual pool suffix, one-state interpreter enumeration, all two-variable source formulas, concrete bad witness.

alternative.claim: The empty-source pin family admits a fixed polynomial witness finder after reading the suffix; prefix avoidance cannot force all-exponent hardness.
alternative.scope: Ordinary explicit input, same U and stage clocks.
alternative.derivation: Decode the selected lifted pins and emit their pattern; the prior universal simulation bound gives some fixed polynomial cutoff.
unresolved_steps: A resource-preserving adversary for full-input computation.
candidate_tests: Replay explicit lifted assignments and exhausted-pattern controls.

objections: Single exponent does not prove P!=NP.
Suffix is readable by longer computations.
Sufficient counting condition can fail at small n.
Fixed-k reduction exponent depends on k.
counterexample_candidates: Empty-source lifted pin family is easy to solve by reading the input.
critic.equivalence_audit: Same U, same input ordering and clock, exact lifted SAT equivalence, prefix output-read bound and residual program count.
critic.barrier_audit: No all-exponent lower bound or P versus NP resolution.
